title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant A (faithful + improvements)

variant.bet: improvements-list applied; no motion; palette proportions unchanged

financeBand.layout: 3-up CSS grid (grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) at desktop; repeat(2, 1fr) at tablet; 1fr at mobile)
financeBand.rationale: Improvement #1 — retire slick.js carousel; all deals visible above the fold.

partnerSentimentBand.headline: merged-into-band (was orphan h5; promoted to h3 inline with partner-logo strip)
partnerSentimentBand.rationale: Improvement #2 — collapse sentiment + partner into one band.

statRow.replacedBy: single narrative-proof line at locations band lead
statRow.rationale: Improvement #4 — narrative proofs replace floating numerals.

heroBand.ground: captured photographic hero with overlay-dark rgba(18,18,18,0.5)
heroBand.headline: Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS at display size (61px desktop)

improvementsApplied.fix: Replace slick.js finance carousel with 3-up card grid; all deals visible above the fold.
Collapse 'WE PROUDLY SUPPORT THE ONES WHO BUILD OUR WORLD' into one band with the partner-logo strip.
Adopt modular type scale 1.250; pin tracking by weight (display 0.02em; label 0.08em).
Retire 18/75/24 floating-numerals stat row; replace with single narrative-proof line.
Hold Cat Yellow at captured proportion (CTA + eyebrow + 1px border). The yellow promotion is variant B's bet, not A's.

bonusContentRules: Alt text required on every image (hero, service tiles, partner logos, branch map).
Plan a monochrome / inverted SVG logo set for downstream variants (B / C); A renders the captured PNG.

rejectedMoves: Custom font (Roboto Condensed + Roboto only — Mode A pinning)
Motion register (A is the static green-light variant)
Yellow as primary surface (B's bet, not A's)
Glassmorphism / gradient text / side-stripes (impeccable absolute bans)
